**Implementation note:** Single-instrument OFI (needs L1 quotes); no cross-sectional model.

## Description

Calculates multi-level Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) metrics across top market depth levels to forecast short-term multi-tick price direction across stock universes.

## Where it may fit

Intraday institutional execution, market open/close order imbalances, momentum continuation trades.

## Vehicles

Intraday statistical arbitrage funds, HFT equity firms, proprietary trading desks.

## Required data

Level 2 Depth of Market tick data, order cancellation events, trade message streams.

## Caveats

Demands high bandwidth and CPU processing power for continuous order book matrix recalculations.
